levels.surface: محمد بن عثمان بن أبي صفوان الثقفي
محمد بن عثمان بن عبد الله

notes: «وأبوه، عثمان بن عبد الله» is the father with his name: one link, the name alone (rule 7)
«أن رجلا، قال يا رسول الله» has a man in the story whose words are the saying: he is not a transmitter (rule 6); the chain ends at أبي أيوب

fixes.reason: RWY takes the man in the story as a transmitter; the text has him as the speaker of the saying inside the story, not as a link.
